top_signals.title: US Job Growth Surged in October, Unemployment Rate Fell
top_signals.summary:
US job growth surged in October and the unemployment rate edged lower, a sign of labor-market strength in an expanding economy.
Nonfarm payrolls increased 165,000 last month, topping all forecasts, after an upward revision to the prior two months.
Claudia Sahm, Chief Economist at New Century Advisors, reacts to the report. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Treasuries Fall as Strong Jobs Data Fortifies Tech Rebound
top_signals.summary: Treasuries fell after strong October employment data and a rebound in technology shares backed wagers that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month.
